title: pgvector connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One pgvector connector instance's settings, read by the native Postgres family (`loams_connector_postgres::PostgresFactory`, CN2 Task 10, OR-9): PostgreSQL with the `vector` extension through the target profile `pgvector`; `vector(n)` columns map to Arrow FixedSizeList<Float32>(n). `mode` picks the batch or CDC source, and a `table` makes the instance an upsert sink. `password` holds the **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), which the connector resolves when it connects; it is exactly the manifest's `secrets` list. CN1's `table`, `schema_name`, `key` and `password` keep their meaning.

host.description: The database host. Every connection goes through the SDK's egress check, after DNS.

user.description: The role the connector logs in as.

password.description: The name of the secret holding the role's password, resolved through the namespace's secret store (D189); never the password itself. Absent: trust or peer authentication. Not used with `auth: iam`, where the password is a freshly minted RDS IAM token.

auth.description: How the instance logs in: `basic` (or its alias `password`) with `password`. AWS RDS IAM tokens (`iam`) are Aurora's (the `aurora` manifest), not this target's.

sslmode.description: `disable`, `require` (encrypt without verifying the certificate) or `verify-full` (verify the chain and the host name). Defaults to `disable`, or `verify-full` with `auth: iam`.

ca_pem.description: Extra trusted roots for `verify-full`, as PEM (the Amazon RDS CA bundle, for example); without it only the webpki roots are trusted.

mode.description: The source: `batch` reads each table in `tables` in key order as Arrow batches; `cdc` streams changes (pgoutput logical replication on Postgres, a sinkless changefeed on CockroachDB) after an initial snapshot.

tables.description: The tables the source reads, `schema.table` or `table` (schema `public`). A string is one table.

key.description: Batch reads: the columns to page by. Sink: the upsert key, INSERT … ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE. Defaults to the table's primary key. Declared because the manifest declares capabilities.sink.upsert: true (CN1 Task 1's semantic rule); CN1's single-column `key` is still accepted as a string.

publication.description: CDC: a publication you manage. Without it the connector creates and owns `loams_<instance>` and drops it when the instance is deleted.

slot.description: CDC: the replication slot name. Default `loams_<namespace>_<instance>`.

snapshot.description: CDC: take the initial snapshot inside the slot's exported snapshot (`initial`), or start streaming at the slot's consistent point (`never`).

streaming.description: CDC: receive in-progress transactions (pgoutput protocol 2, PostgreSQL 14+), buffered per transaction until it commits.

stream_buffer_bytes.description: CDC: the most one streamed in-progress transaction may buffer.

heartbeat_ms.description: CDC: the idle heartbeat (`pg_logical_emit_message`) that keeps the slot moving on a quiet database; 0 disables it.

status_interval_ms.description: CDC: the Standby Status Update interval, which is also the keepalive.

resolved_ms.description: CockroachDB changefeeds: the `resolved` timestamp interval. Read only on a CockroachDB target.

table.description: Sink: the table rows are upserted into, `schema.table` or `table`. Setting it makes the instance a sink.

schema_name.description: Sink: the schema an unqualified `table` is in (CN1's meaning).

transactional.description: Sink: commit each batch in one transaction with the instance's row in `_loams_checkpoints`, fenced by the lease epoch (exactly once). False makes a plain at-least-once upsert sink.

evolution.description: The schema evolution policy (see the schema-mapping guide).

lossy.description: Conversions allowed to lose information, by path (for example a `timestamp without time zone` column read as UTC).
